# TradingCoreOS overlay on Vela 0.10.6

The vendored upstream source snapshot is Vela 0.10.6 at release commit
f6769868c5c0e78ba7977a5c89640df896a8f2f3; the direct 0.10.5 source base was
34d11f1a8a88c7dd5657c9b3a791abf43560218d. The overlay's earlier historical ancestor was Vela 0.10.2;
that older base is retained only as historical context and is not used as the
0.10.6 merge base. TCO-owned behavior remains explicitly mapped in
vendor/vela/patches.json.

Do not identify a TCO-local edit as an upstream change just because it lives
under vendor/vela/src. The source manifest is generated by
tools/vela-overlay-manifest.mjs against the exact pinned release.
